title: Fire Department Light Duty Emergency Vehicles

onscreen_lines.desc: 2026 Ford Maverick XL AWD SuperCrew Pickup Truck
onscreen_lines.note: Vehicle shall be delivered complete, serviced, and ready for operation. Bid price must include destination charges, dealer preparation, delivery, title fees, and all other applicable costs, excluding taxes from which the City is exempt. Bidders shall provide the manufacturer, model, model year, complete specifications, warranty information, estimated delivery date, and anticipated lead time for each vehicle offered. Any deviation from the specifications must be clearly identified with the bid response. Failure to identify an exception will constitute the bidder’s agreement to furnish vehicles fully compliant with the specifications. Vehicles must be new and unused, with no prior retail owner or registration. Vehicles shall not be demos, rental vehicles, previously titled vehicles, or vehicles with aftermarket modifications unless specifically approved by the City. The City may award by individual line item, in whole or in part, based on availability, compliance with specifications, delivery timeframe, and total cost.
